# Third-party notices

The public selection paths, DOM labels and page-selection checks are adapted from [oh-story-claudecode's Qimao scanner](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/main/skills/story-long-scan/scripts/qimao-rank-scraper.js), retained in the user's [fork](https://github.com/felir7at62co-wq/oh-story-claudecode). The reviewed source identity is recorded in the artifact's `SOURCE.json`. Muse uses static parse5 HTML parsing and its own scoped tools and request lifecycle; the upstream Chrome/CDP driver is not bundled or executed.
